open_points.subject: store symbolic-link handling after start
open_points.text: A18 now says “The database file and its journal are opened by SQLite, which Python cannot ask to refuse a link” and “sqlite_files(database) after start -> not watched”, while State 3 says `store` owns “refusal of symbolic links” and hides “opening without following links” without excluding SQLite-managed files.
open_points.question: Does `store`'s State 3 responsibility to refuse symbolic links exclude the database and SQLite-created journal files after startup, or must those files also be opened or monitored without following links?
options: The new A18 exception governs: SQLite-managed database and journal files are checked only at startup and are not watched afterward.
The State 3 responsibility governs: `store` must arrange no-follow opening or post-start monitoring for SQLite-managed files.
The exception applies only to journal files; the main database file must still be protected after startup.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the new, specific A18 text as controlling and exclude SQLite-managed database and journal files from `store`'s post-start no-follow guarantee.
